name: strict-vdp
description: Default rule set mirroring a strict vulnerability-disclosure policy (rewrite it to your program's exact published text; the reviewer only judges against what is written here).
accepted_classes: arbitrary file upload / deletion / download with full path and extension control
privilege escalation to contributor level or above
broken access control on genuinely sensitive objects only (API keys, secrets, password hashes, backup or SQL files)
IDOR with significant impact (personal-data leakage alone is NOT significant)
stored XSS that executes on page open with zero interaction, unauthenticated or low-privilege reachable
CSRF only when it chains into one of the accepted write actions above
denial of service only when the whole site crashes
rejected_classes: user or account enumeration and other low-impact information disclosure
personal-data-limited broken access control or IDOR
CSRF that does not chain into an accepted write action
role prerequisites at or below contributor level
self-XSS or XSS requiring unusual interaction

format_requirements.version: the latest released version of the component at the time of writing
format_requirements.poc_perspective: remote attacker over HTTP; steps a third party can follow end to end; the full PoC lives in the report body, not only in attachments
format_requirements.consolidation: multiple findings of the same type go into ONE report
format_requirements.impact: quantified with its denominator or a concrete demonstrated attacker outcome

risk_notes: an untested or assumption-based report can earn an immediate temporary ban
a high rejection rate can remove the reporter from the program
